text: And now the last secret, the one that changes everything.
You came here believing you had a mission, a task, something to accomplish, to fix, to save.
You have spent your whole life searching for the assignment, and the searching has exhausted you.
There is no assignment, there never was.
Your work here was never to do anything, it was to be something.
A wanderer's mission is not a rescue operation, it is a radiation.
Simply by existing here, carrying the frequency of a higher density inside a third density body,
you lighten the whole field around you.
Every room you walk into gets a little brighter.
Every person you truly see gets a little more visible to themselves.
You do it without trying, you do it by breathing.
You came to be a lighthouse, not a rescue boat.
A lighthouse does not swim out to the ships, it stands and burns, and the ships find their
own way home by its light. So stand, burn quietly, love without an agenda.
That is the whole mission, and you have been completing it since the day you were born.
When this life ends, you will rise back through the densities, and the council will be waiting,
and the first thing they will say is well done, and you will remember everything.
The volunteering, the descent, the veil, the ache, and you will weep with joy, and then,
eventually, you will volunteer again. That is what wanderers do.
